mh_standards_13_20_070.front_yard_note: Each mobile home placed no closer than 5 ft back from the sidewalk, or the roadway if there is no sidewalk; includes attached appurtenances (stairs, awnings, carports, etc.); no structure may encroach in the 5 ft setback (structure includes the roof overhang).
mh_standards_13_20_070.max_lot_coverage_note: §13.20.070(L): lot coverage shall not exceed 75% of the lot; 'occupied' means covered by a mobile home/manufactured home, garage, carport, cabana, awning, storage building, or structure of any kind. The front-yard area within 3 ft of the side and rear lot lines must remain open and unobstructed to the sky.
mh_standards_13_20_070.rear_yard_note: Dwelling structures and other main buildings ≥10 ft rear separation; accessory buildings ≥3 ft from the adjacent lot line; corner lots rearing upon another lot's side yard: accessory buildings ≥3 ft to such side yard. Measured from the outer edges of overhangs/eaves. Exception: 13.22.040A7 (not extracted).
mh_standards_13_20_070.side_yard_note: Dwelling structures and other main buildings ≥7'6" from each lot line, both combined ≥15 ft; private garage and other accessory buildings or awnings ≥3 ft; corner-lot street-facing side yard ≥10 ft for main and accessory buildings. Measured from the outer edges of overhangs/eaves. Exception: subsection 13.22.040A7 (not extracted).
mh_standards_13_20_070.standards_note: All manufactured homes must conform to the state of Utah national manufactured housing construction and safety standards act of 1974 with proper certification; MH subdivisions follow the city subdivision review process; private-street standards via administrative conditional use; common areas maintained by an owners' association. (Ord. 13-24, 10-16-2013)

ratios.apartments_covered_parking_note: No less than 1.5 covered parking spaces (1.0 carports, 0.5 garages) per unit.
ratios.assisted_living_nursing_convalescent: 0.5 space per bed, plus 10% for support staff/physicians, plus a bus-only parking stall to meet the dimensions of a handicap parking stall
ratios.dwelling_singlefamily: 2 spaces per dwelling unit (within an enclosed garage)
ratios.parking_unlisted_use_rule: §13.24.080(A): parking for uses not specifically listed shall be provided in the same ratio as the use most nearly approximating the characteristics of the unlisted use, as determined by the planning commission (nonadministrative conditional uses) or the director (permitted and administrative conditional uses).
ratios.senior_or_elderly_housing: 1 space per unit. The ratio may be reduced to 1 space per unit for any congregate care facility, provided that adequate space is created and landscaped that can be converted to additional parking stalls; the reserve area shall not be within a required landscape setback and shall not be used in calculations for required landscaping or open-space coverage.

Column 1 (4 u/acre) provisionally assigned RM-4: the RM-N = N u/acre correspondence is exact for all 6 named columns, and RM-4 appears as an applied district label on official City zoning maps in 7 PC staff reports (2022-01-14 to 2025-06-02: PMN files 804401, 859213, 1025193, 1094979, 1142841, 1223809, 1299871). commercial_13_23_070_screening.masonry_wall: For commercial and industrial developments abutting residential districts (except recognizable holding zones for future commercial or industrial development), an opaque masonry wall shall be installed and maintained along all district boundaries, other than streets, where the premises abut areas zoned for residential uses. Acceptable materials: brick, stone, precast concrete panel, concrete block, or other masonry as the Director may approve; concrete panels and posts reinforced with rebar and wire as determined by the chief building official.
commercial_13_23_070_screening.wall_height_ft: minimum 6, maximum 8; Planning Commission may vary on adjacent residents' request for unusual circumstances (views, landscaping, etc.); lower height may be required adjacent to a front property line for sight distance/traffic safety
